string.name: analyse
string.comment: A button label describing an action. "Analyse" or evaluate a chess position or game.

string.name: onTheServer
string.comment: A header label capturing the property of being shared with others, stored remotely at Lichess, or computed by Lichess. Contrast with "Current analysis" which is visible on the user's device.

string.name: currentAnalysis
string.comment: Phrase to describe analysis results that are currently visible on a game or study chapter's move list and underboard. The current main line analysis being viewed can have a remote origin or be local to the device, but only one analysis can be Current at a time.

string.name: local
string.comment: A short inline label describing the property of being computed on a user's own device rather than the Lichess server, usually preceding an engine name

string.name: published
string.comment: Equivalent in meaning to "On the server", this inline label refers to the property of being stored/published remotely. But whereas "On the server" is a header label used in contrast with "Current analysis", "Published" is used inline like "Local" in brief text descriptions of analysis provenance

string.name: nodesPerMove
string.comment: A strength metric for chess analysis. "Nodes per move" is roughly the average number of hypothetical positions considered by a chess engine when evaluating each move

string.name: using
string.comment: A brief inline label preceding the name of the chess engine responsible for generating the current analysis visible in the user's move list.

string.name: willUse
string.comment: A label preceding the chess engine that will be used to evaluate the full game if the user clicks the Analyse button.

string.name: quality
string.comment: Label for a slider control to choose the overall strength/quality for an upcoming analysis.

string.name: publish
string.comment: Label for an action button that uploads/publishes a local analysis to the server to share it with others.

string.name: chooseYourEngineSettings
string.comment: A brief instruction on how to trigger the analysis process.

string.name: bestResultsUseXWithYThreads
string.comment: %1$s is the engine name and %2$s is the ideal thread count for a standard main line analysis on the user's device. Recommended threads correspond to the number of CPU cores.

resources.string: Za najboljše rezultate v najkrajšem času uporabite %1$s z nitmi %2$s.

string.name: analysisUploadFailed
string.comment: An error message indicating failure to publish for an unspecified reason. This message should be friendly, vague, and counsel patience because the problem may be temporary.

resources.string: Nalaganje analize ni uspelo. Poskusite znova pozneje.

string.name: serverAnalysisInProgress
string.comment: An error message shown when a user attempts to publish a local analysis but a pending server analysis must complete first.

resources.string: Za to igro poteka analiza strežnika. Ko bo ta končana, lahko poskusite znova.

string.name: youCanPublish
string.comment: A short hint shown alongside the Publish button indicating that action's availability.

resources.string: Vaša lokalna analiza je lahko objavljena.

string.name: turnOnRec
string.comment: REC refers to the toggle mode button found in a study's underboard area that enables contributors to make shared modifications. It must be toggled on to publish analyses. This error string is shown when the user clicks Publish without first enabling REC mode.

resources.string: Preden lahko delite lokalno analizo s študijo, morate omogočiti REC.

string.name: whenUpgradingOldChapters
string.comment: A warning shown when a user attempts to Publish fresh results to a study chapter with existing, older server analysis that lacks metadata allowing removal prior to merging new analysis in. If they don't heed this warning, they'll have some cleaning up to do afterwards.

resources.string: Analize na strežniku za poglavja, ustvarjena pred uvedbo lokalne analize, ni mogoče brezhibno nadgraditi. Starejše linije in komentarji v analizi bodo ostali, razen če jih najprej odstranite.

string.name: startingPosition
string.comment: A progress label that shows after Analyse is clicked but before results for the first move have been calculated. Once move results begin arriving, this text becomes "Move X of Y" to indicate progress.

string.name: keepThisBrowserTabActive
string.comment: A reminder not to close the browser tab while analysis is running.

resources.string: Med analizo naj bo ta zavihek brskalnika aktiven

string.name: xTimesStandardQuality
string.comment: "Standard" is a unit label that correlates to the strength of a fishnet analysis. This phrase is shown as progress information to describe the analysis strength the engine is currently generating.

string.name: moveXOfY
string.comment: %$1s is the current move being processed, where %2$s is the total number of moves.

string.name: downloadingXofY
string.comment: A phrase shown when downloading a large engine prior to running analysis. %1$s will be a percentage string like "32%" whereas %2$s will be the total download size in megabytes like "94MB"

string.name: timeToComplete
string.comment: An estimate of time required given to users prior to starting an analysis. %s is the placeholder for a duration string like "5 minutes"

string.name: xWouldBeFaster
string.comment: A hint (prior to starting analysis) that they should use "engine X" (currently Stockfish 19 94MB) to achieve the quickest results.
